items.en: English display meant to spread out a banner.
items.cn: 英语 display 最初指展开旗帜。

items.en: It now covers goods, feelings and lit screens.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖货物、情绪与发光的屏幕。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the play-like ending, and the meaning group names other ways of showing.
note.cn: 形近组保留近似 play 的词尾，近义组列出别的展示方式。

entries.definition: to take part in a game or a performance
a second showing of a recorded action
put out where people can see it
to show something in a public place
to let something be seen
a flat surface that shows images

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a lit glass case and end with a pane of light.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只亮起的玻璃柜开始，落到一块发光的平面。

normal.en: Dis- plus play: the folded thing is opened out.
normal.cn: dis 加 play，把折着的东西展开。

normal.en: A window display sells before any word is spoken.
normal.cn: 橱窗陈列在任何一句话之前就在卖货。

normal.en: A face can display what a mouth refuses to say.
normal.cn: 嘴不肯说的，脸可以先显示出来。

normal.en: The display on a phone is a window made of glass and light.
normal.cn: 手机的显示屏，是一扇玻璃与光做的窗。

normal.en: Goods on display are easier to want than to need.
normal.cn: 陈列着的货，容易让人想买，而不是需要。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switched on above a glass shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃架上方的灯亮了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a box so the label faces out.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把盒子转得标签朝外。

abstract.en: Picture a small screen glowing in a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象暗屋里一块小屏在发光。

examples.en: Her face displayed no sign of worry.
examples.cn: 她脸上没有显出担忧。

examples.en: The museum displays old maps in a long hall.
examples.cn: 博物馆在一条长廊里展示旧地图。

examples.en: The display on the machine showed an error.
examples.cn: 机器上的显示屏显示了错误。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 display 记成「摆开来看」：dis 表示展开，词根与折叠的拉丁词有关，把折起的东西摊开摆好，就是展示。

root: 源自拉丁语 displicare（展开），由 dis-（分开）与 plicare（折叠）构成，经古法语 despleier 进入英语。本义是把折起或卷起的东西摊开，所以有「摆出来给人看」的意思，后来指把情绪显在脸上，现代又指发光的显示屏。

sensesIntro.en: From a banner spread open in the air to a pane of light on a desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 从空中展开的旗帜，到桌上那块发光的平面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit glass case with every label facing out.
core.cn: 核心意象：亮起的玻璃柜，每张标签都朝外。

branches.en: The first sense is an object spread out for the eyes.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是摆出来给眼睛看的物件。

branches.en: The second sense is a feeling laid open the same way.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是用同样方式摊开的情绪。

branches.en: The third sense is the glass that does the showing.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是替人展示的那块玻璃。

branches.en: Both senses depend on being looked at.
branches.cn: 两个义项都要被看见才成立。

branches.en: A face and a screen both show without sound.
branches.cn: 脸和屏幕都能无声地显示。

intro.en: Display belongs to the plicare family of folding, where unfold and employ share a root.
intro.cn: display 属于 plicare（折叠）一族，展开与使用共用同一个根。

latinIntro.en: Latin plicare, to fold, gives displicare and display, and the same stem hides in employ and reply.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plicare（折叠）给出 displicare 与 display，同一词干也藏在 employ 与 reply 里。

items.example: They display the cups near the door.
items.exampleCN: 他们把杯子陈列在门边。

items.example: The maps were displayed in a hall.
He was displaying a rare calm.
The results are displayable on one page.
items.exampleCN: 结果可以展示在一页上。

items.example: The shop redisplayed the window.

items.meaning: a person or thing that shows
items.example: A small displayer held the price.
items.exampleCN: 一个小展示架托着价签。

items.meaning: a board used for showing notices
items.example: A display board stood by the gate.
The display window was full of hats.

definition_en: a serious disagreement, or to argue that something is not true
core_image: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各按着同一张纸的一角
scene: 两个人隔着一张桌子，各自按住同一张纸的一角。The two families have been in dispute for years.
sceneCN: 这里 dispute 指「争端」（第 1 个义项：长期未决的争执）；句意是这两家已经争了多年。

senses.title: A serious disagreement
senses.definition: a serious disagreement that lasts or becomes public
senses.definitionCN: 持续或公开的严重分歧
senses.example: The two families have been in dispute for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这两家已经争了多年。
senses.why: One sheet of paper, two hands, no shared edge.
senses.whyCN: 一张纸，两只手，找不到共同的一边。

senses.title: To argue that something is false
senses.definition: to say that something is not true or not right
senses.definitionCN: 声称某事不真实或不对
senses.example: He disputed the amount on the bill.
senses.exampleCN: 他质疑账单上的金额。
senses.why: To dispute is to hold the paper and pull.
senses.whyCN: 质疑，就是按住那张纸往回拉。

intro.en: Dispute comes from Latin disputare, to argue a question, from dis- and putare, to think or reckon.
intro.cn: dispute 来自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis- 与 putare（思考、计算）构成。

items.en: Putare meant to think, to reckon or to prune.
items.cn: putare 指思考、计算，也指修剪。

items.en: Disputare meant to reckon a matter from both sides.
items.cn: disputare 指把事情两面都算一遍。

items.en: Disputer meant to argue or to quarrel.
items.cn: 古法语 disputer 指辩论或争吵。

items.en: English dispute named a formal argument.
items.cn: 英语 dispute 指正式的辩论。

items.en: It now also means to question a fact or a bill.
items.cn: 今天它也指对事实或账单提出质疑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dispute stem, and the meaning group names other forms of conflict.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dispute 词干，近义组列出别的冲突形式。

entries.definition: open to argument
a person who argues a case
argued about by others
a heated exchange of views
an angry disagreement between people
entries.definitionCN: 人与人之间带怒气的争执

entries.definition: a call to prove or defend something
entries.definitionCN: 要求证明或辩护的挑战

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two hands on one sheet and end with a paper finally settled.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两只手按住一张纸开始，落到一张终于说定的纸。

normal.en: Dis- plus pute: two sides reckon the same sum apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 pute，两方各算一遍同一笔账。

normal.en: A dispute over pay can stop a whole factory.
normal.cn: 薪酬上的争执，能让整座工厂停下。

normal.en: The land in dispute has no fence left standing.
normal.cn: 有争议的那块地，篱笆早没了。

normal.en: To dispute a bill is to ask for the sum again.
normal.cn: 质疑一张账单，就是要求再算一遍。

normal.en: An undisputed fact needs no loud voice.
normal.cn: 无可争议的事实，不需要大声。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pulling opposite corners.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手各拉一角。

abstract.en: Picture a torn edge between two people.
abstract.cn: 想象两人中间一道撕开的边。

abstract.en: Picture a third chair brought to the table.
abstract.cn: 想象桌边多搬来一把椅子。

examples.en: The two families have been in dispute for years.
examples.cn: 这两家已经争了多年。

examples.en: He disputed the amount on the bill.
examples.cn: 他质疑账单上的金额。

examples.en: The land is still in dispute between the villages.
examples.cn: 这块地仍在两村之间争执不下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dispute 记成「各算各的」：dis 是分开，put 与思考、计算同源；两个人分开各算一遍，算不到一处，就成了争端。

root: 源自拉丁语 disputare（辩论一个问题），由 dis-（分开）与 putare（思考、计算、修剪）构成，经古法语 disputer 进入英语。本义是两方各自把账算一遍，因此既指争执本身，也指对某个说法提出质疑。

sensesIntro.en: From two separate reckonings of one sum to the argument that follows.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对同一笔账的两次计算，到随之而来的争执。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands on opposite corners of one sheet of paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手按着同一张纸相对的两角。

branches.en: The first sense is the long disagreement itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那场长期的分歧。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of pulling at one fact.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是对某个事实的拉扯。

branches.en: Both senses need at least two sides.
branches.cn: 两个义项都至少需要两方。

branches.en: Both can end when someone reads the paper again.
branches.cn: 两个义项都可能在有人重读那张纸时结束。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be done by one person alone.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能由一个人单独完成。

intro.en: Dispute belongs to the Latin putare family, where thinking, reckoning and arguing share a stem.
intro.cn: dispute 属于拉丁语 putare 一族，思考、计算与争辩共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin putare, to reckon, gives disputare and dispute, with dis- marking two separate reckonings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 putare（计算）给出 disputare 与 dispute，前缀 dis- 标出两次分开的计算。

items.example: They dispute the price every year.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年都为价格争执。

items.example: The claim is disputable.
Each disputant had a turn.
The disputation lasted two hours.
Her skill is undisputed.
The disputed border stayed closed.
items.exampleCN: 有争议的边界仍然关闭。

items.example: Two clerks stood disputing the sum.
items.exampleCN: 两名职员站着争那笔钱。

items.example: A disputatious mind enjoys a quarrel.
items.exampleCN: 爱争辩的头脑喜欢争吵。

definition_en: the amount of space between two places or things, or a cool gap between people
core_image: 两盏路灯之间那段走不到头的黑
scene: 街这头看得见那头的灯，中间隔着一大段黑。She walked the whole distance without looking back.
sceneCN: 这里 distance 指「距离」（第 1 个义项：两点之间的远近）；句意是她走完全程都没有回头。

collocations.phrase: at a distance of ten metres

senses.title: The space between two points
senses.definition: the amount of space between two places or things
senses.definitionCN: 两个地点或物体之间的空间大小
senses.example: Measure the distance between the two posts.
senses.exampleCN: 量一量两根柱子之间的距离。
senses.why: Space becomes something you can count in steps.
senses.whyCN: 空间变成了可以用脚步去数的东西。

senses.title: The far part of a view
senses.definition: the place far away that you can see but not reach easily
senses.definitionCN: 看得见却不容易走到的那片远处
senses.example: A light shone in the distance.
senses.exampleCN: 远处亮着一盏灯。
senses.why: The eye stops at the horizon and calls it a place.
senses.whyCN: 目光停在地平线上，就把它叫作一个地方。

senses.title: A cool gap between people
senses.definition: a lack of closeness between people, or the act of keeping apart
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间缺少亲近，或主动保持间隔
senses.example: A quiet distance grew between the brothers.
senses.exampleCN: 兄弟之间渐渐生出一种沉默的疏远。
senses.why: Two people in one room can still be miles apart.
senses.whyCN: 同在一间屋里，两个人也可能隔着好几里。

intro.en: Distance comes from Latin distantia, a standing apart, built on dis-, apart, and stare, to stand.
intro.cn: distance 来自拉丁语 distantia（相隔而立），由 dis-（分开）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand still and hold a position.
items.cn: stare 指站定不动、守住位置。

items.en: Dis- pushed the two standing points apart.
items.cn: dis- 把两个站立点推开。

items.en: Distantia measured how far apart they stood.
items.cn: distantia 量的是它们相隔多远。

items.en: Old French destance carried the measure of space.
items.cn: 古法语 destance 承接了空间尺度的意思。

items.en: English used it for space, then for time and feeling.
items.cn: 英语先用它量空间，再用来量时间与感情。

items.en: Today it covers miles, years and a cool silence.
items.cn: 今天它可以指数英里、数年，也指一段冷淡的沉默。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the stant stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of gap.
note.cn: 形近组共享 stant 这一段词干，近义组则是几个表示间隔的词。

entries.definition: far away in space or time
equally far from two points
to leave others far behind
an empty space between two things
the full length from one end to the other
entries.definitionCN: 从一端到另一端的全长

entries.definition: the state of being far away

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two points standing apart and end with two people who no longer speak.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从两个站开的点开始，落到两个不再说话的人。

normal.en: Dis- plus stance: two standing points held apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stance，就是两个站立的点被分开。

normal.en: The bridge is two kilometres away, a short distance by car.
normal.cn: 那座桥在两公里外，开车是很短的距离。

normal.en: A figure appeared in the distance and came closer.
normal.cn: 远处出现一个人影，慢慢走近。

normal.en: He distanced himself from the quarrel.
normal.cn: 他与这场争吵保持了距离。

normal.en: Old friends can drift into a polite distance.
normal.cn: 老朋友也会慢慢疏成客气的距离。

abstract.en: Picture two lamps with a long stretch of dark between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两盏灯之间拉着一段长长的黑。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid on a map, end on end.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺子在地图上一段段量过去。

abstract.en: Picture two chairs pushed slowly towards opposite walls.
abstract.cn: 想象两把椅子慢慢被推向相对的墙。

examples.en: The distance between the two towns is forty miles.
examples.cn: 两座城镇之间相距四十英里。

examples.en: He distanced himself from the decision.
examples.cn: 他与那个决定保持了距离。

examples.en: A dog barked in the distance.
examples.cn: 远处有只狗在叫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distance 记成「站开一段」：dis 表示分开，st 与 stand 同源表示站，两个点站开，中间就留出了距离。

root: 源自拉丁语 distantia，由表示分开的 dis- 与表示站立的 stare 构成，本义是两个点相隔而立。英语先用它量空间，后来也量时间，再引申为人与人之间的冷淡与疏远。

sensesIntro.en: From a measured space on a road to the quiet widening of a gap between two people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从路上量出的一段空间，到两个人之间悄悄拉大的空档。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lamps standing far apart with a long stretch of dark between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两盏灯远远分开，中间拉着一大段黑。

branches.en: The first sense is plain measurable space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是可以直接量出来的空间。

branches.en: The second sense puts that space in the far background of a view.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这段空间放到视野的最远处。

branches.en: The third sense turns space into coldness between people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把空间变成人与人之间的冷淡。

branches.en: Both senses describe a measurable gap, one in metres and one in feeling.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在说可量的间隔，一个用米，一个用感受。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a viewpoint that feels the gap.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个能感到这段间隔的视角。

intro.en: Distance sits in the stance family, where Latin stare, to stand, holds the whole group together.
intro.cn: distance 属于 stance 一族，中心是拉丁语 stare（站立），把整组词撑在一起。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, to stand, gives stance and distance; dis- makes the standing points separate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stare（站立）给出 stance 与 distance，前缀 dis- 让两个站立点分开。

items.meaning: the space held between two points
items.example: The distance between the towns is forty miles.
items.exampleCN: 两镇之间相距四十英里。

items.example: His stance was firm and wide.

items.meaning: to stay upright on the feet
items.example: They stood by the gate for an hour.
items.exampleCN: 他们在门口站了一个小时。

items.example: A distant hill turned blue.

items.meaning: in a far or cool way
items.example: She smiled distantly and said nothing.
items.exampleCN: 她淡淡一笑，什么也没说。

items.example: The village is equidistant from both cities.
items.exampleCN: 这个村子到两座城市等距。

items.meaning: to get far ahead of others
items.example: She outdistanced the whole field.
items.exampleCN: 她把全场选手远远甩开。

items.meaning: the conditions standing around an event
items.example: Under these circumstances we waited.
items.exampleCN: 在这种情况下我们等了等。

definition_en: far away in space or time, or not friendly and not paying attention
core_image: 山顶的信号塔在雾里只剩一个模糊的小点
scene: 车开出很久，那座塔缩成雾里的一个小点。He grew distant after the argument.
sceneCN: 这里 distant 指「疏远的」（第 3 个义项：不再亲近）；句意是争吵之后他变得疏远起来。

senses.title: Far away in space
senses.definition: a long way from the place where you are
senses.definitionCN: 离你所在之处有很长一段路
senses.example: A distant hill turned blue in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 雨里远处的山变成了蓝色。
senses.why: The further a thing is, the fewer details it keeps.
senses.whyCN: 东西越远，留下的细节越少。

senses.title: Far back in time
senses.definition: happening a long time ago or a long time from now
senses.definitionCN: 发生在很久以前或很久以后
senses.example: Those are stories from the distant past.
senses.exampleCN: 那些是很久以前的故事。
senses.why: Memory thins the years the way fog thins a hill.
senses.whyCN: 记忆把年月磨淡，就像雾把山磨淡。

senses.title: Cool and not quite present
senses.definition: not friendly, or not paying attention to what is here
senses.definitionCN: 不亲近，或没有把心思放在眼前
senses.example: She gave a distant nod and left.
senses.exampleCN: 她冷淡地点了下头就走了。
senses.why: A mind can move far away while the body stays in the chair.
senses.whyCN: 人还坐在椅子上，心思却能走得很远。

intro.en: Distant is the Latin present participle distans, from distare, to stand apart, built on dis- and stare.
intro.cn: distant 是拉丁语现在分词 distans，来自 distare（相隔而立），由 dis- 与 stare 组成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand and keep a place.
items.cn: stare 指站着并守住一个位置。

items.en: Dis- marked the space between the two places.
items.cn: dis- 标出两处之间的间隔。

items.en: Distans described things that stood far from each other.
items.cn: distans 描述彼此站得很远的东西。

items.en: English used it first for places on a map.
items.cn: 英语先用它说地图上的地点。

items.en: It spread to years, relatives and cool manners.
items.cn: 后来扩展到年月、亲戚与冷淡的举止。

items.en: A distant look now means a mind somewhere else.
items.cn: 今天 a distant look 指心思飘在别处。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the same standing stem, while the meaning group gathers words for far and unfriendly.
note.cn: 形近组共享「站立」这段词干，近义组则是几个表示远与冷淡的词。

entries.definition: the space between two points
in a far or cool manner
equally far from two points
a long way away
far from towns and hard to reach
friendly in no obvious way

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a small point on the horizon and end with a mind that has left the room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从地平线上的一个小点开始，落到一颗已经离屋的心思。

normal.en: Dis- plus stant: the two standing points are far apart.
normal.cn: dis 加 stant，两个站立的点隔得很开。

normal.en: A distant light on the coast means the harbour is still far.
normal.cn: 海岸上远远一盏灯，说明港口还远。

normal.en: Letters from a distant cousin arrived once a year.
normal.cn: 远房表亲的信一年来一封。

normal.en: His voice went distant when the subject came up.
normal.cn: 话题一提起，他的声音就远了。

normal.en: She seemed distant, as if listening to another room.
normal.cn: 她显得心不在焉，像在听另一个房间。

abstract.en: Picture a tower shrinking to a dot in fog.
abstract.cn: 想象一座塔在雾里缩成一个小点。

abstract.en: Picture an old photograph with faces too small to name.
abstract.cn: 想象一张老照片，脸小得认不出。

abstract.en: Picture a person answering a question a second late.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人回答问题时慢了一拍。

examples.en: The distant mountains were lost in cloud.
examples.cn: 远处的山隐进云里。

examples.en: A distant train sounded across the valley.
examples.cn: 一列火车的声音从山谷那头传来。

examples.en: He was polite but distant with strangers.
examples.cn: 他对陌生人客气而疏远。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 distant 记成「站得远」：dis 表示分开，stant 与 stand 同源表示站着，站得开，就是远的，也可以指心思离得远。

root: 源自拉丁语 distare（相隔而立），由 dis-（分开）与 stare（站立）构成，现在分词为 distans。本义是位置离得远，后来用于时间上的久远，再引申为人情上的冷淡与心思上的不专注。

sensesIntro.en: From a hill far beyond the river to a face that answers you from a great distance.
sensesIntro.cn: 从河那边很远的山，到一张仿佛从很远处回答你的脸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tower on a hill shrinking into a dot in the fog.
core.cn: 核心意象：山上的塔在雾里缩成一个小点。

branches.en: The first sense is simple physical separation.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是单纯的空间相隔。

branches.en: The second sense measures separation in years.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用年月来量这段相隔。

branches.en: The third sense measures it in warmth between people.
branches.cn: 第三个义项用人与人之间的温度来量。

branches.en: Both senses keep one thing out of easy reach.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让某样东西不容易够到。

branches.en: Both senses grow stronger the longer nothing is said.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是越久不开口，就越显得明显。

intro.en: Distant gathers the stance family, where Latin stare, to stand, holds the stem steady.
intro.cn: distant 聚起 stance 一族，中心是拉丁语 stare（站立），把词干稳稳撑住。

latinIntro.en: Latin stare, to stand, gives stance and distant; dis- turns standing together into standing apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 stare（站立）给出 stance 与 distant，前缀 dis- 把站在一起变成站得很开。

items.example: A distant hill turned blue.

items.meaning: in a far or cool way
items.example: He answered distantly.
The town is equidistant from both ports.
items.exampleCN: 这座镇到两个港口等距。

items.example: She outdistanced every rival.
items.exampleCN: 她把所有对手都甩开了。

items.example: He took a firm stance.
They stood in the rain.

items.meaning: the conditions standing around an event
items.example: The circumstances changed fast.
